(1) MAHC (mahc_hierarchical on): each pipeline that returned an in-scope list votes with weight w = max(pi, 1e-4) / (sigma^2 + 1e-4), normalised (sigma None counts as 1; skipped, failed and abstained pipelines do not vote); weighted Borda, rank r of n scores (n - r + 1)/n, ties by name; fused sigma = sqrt(sum w sigma^2). (2) Priors pi (M-a): a pipeline's top-3 hit rate on build cases with the same trigger signal type, smoothed toward its global rate with 10 pseudo-cases, used only with at least 30 build cases where the pipeline gave a list, else the global rate; a pipeline never seen weighs 1. Signal type: for the trigger's top suspect, its metric series with the largest causal z at the trigger bucket, classified by name: error (error, fail, 5xx), then latency (latency, duration, response_time), then resource (cpu, mem, memory, gc, thread, fd, disk, socket), else unclassified; z ties (z is capped at 50) go to the reverse-alphabetically larger name; the series need not have crossed (a log-driven trigger is typed by the suspect's strongest metric series); a fallback trigger or a window without metrics is unclassified; the detector is unchanged. The modality level is dropped. (3) Calibrated confidence (M-b, replaces Ch3's entropy floor): features of the fused result (top-1 share, entropy / log n, fused sigma, contributing pipelines, top-1s agree) -> logistic score of standardised features (L2 strength 1) -> isotonic regression to P(root in fused top 3): equal scores pooled first, then pool-adjacent-violators, knots on the score computed from the stored (rounded) parameters; a score maps to the value of the last knot at or below it (the first knot's value below the range). (4) Fitting: nested cross-fitting on outer folds = OTel by root service, RCAEval by system; within a training set each case's features come from priors fitted without its group; no case is scored by priors or a calibrator that saw its group. The frozen parameters are refitted on all build cases (priors on all; calibrator on group-held-out features). (5) Floor (M-c, M-e): per corpus the lowest held-out confidence c with HR@3 >= 0.8 among cases with confidence >= c; the floor is the stricter corpus's; if a corpus has no such c the build run stops and is brought to the owner (no automatic fallback). CONFIRMED when every pipeline is in and confidence >= floor, else PROVISIONAL + human request. (6) Timing: pipeline latencies replayed as if concurrent, except that G-pipe starts after D-pipe's routing gate (its finish time is D-pipe's latency plus its own): first publication at the earlier of 30 s and all pipelines done, from those done; terminal when all are done within 90 s; otherwise non-converged (PROVISIONAL + human request, fused from pipelines done by 90 s). The scored list is the terminal one; TTT = first publication of any state (the contract's "first PROVISIONAL" read as first publication, since variants with no gate never publish a PROVISIONAL); timing fields are outside rerun equality and reported as measured on the stated hardware, except at the 90 s cutoff: a pipeline that finishes after 90 s on one run and before it on another changes the state (NON_CONVERGED) and drops that pipeline from the scored list; non_converged is stored per run and reported. change: Engine and narrators: the Narrative Engine (helios/narrative/, gated by VCLFlag.COE_NARRATIVE; HELIOS-noExpl shows the ranked list only) writes one narrative per stored run from that run's CoE entry alone. A narrative is a code-filled header (fused top 3, confidence, state) and three slots: story, contradictions, verification. The narrator is chosen by l2c_llm: off (HELIOS-noLLM, -D, -G), a deterministic template narrator that never calls a model (N-a); on, an LLM narrator on the frozen llama3.1:8b (digest 46e0c10c039e) through L-pipe's gateway and response cache, one call per slot. Both emit typed claims (ranking, shift, call_structure, log_message, contradiction, verification_step) that cite CoE IDs. L-pipe worker claims are not citable. Kind rules: a deterministic verifier accepts a claim only if every cite exists and the kind's rule holds: a shift needs the claim's own D-pipe channel item, with its direction taken from the cited before/after levels; a call_structure claim needs the caller → callee edge in the cited G-pipe item; a log snippet must be at least 12 characters, a whole-word run of the cited line, quoted once in the sentence; a ranking claim must match the fused ranking; a contradiction's pipeline must be in the disagree list; a verification step's target must be in the fused top 3 or a cited caller/callee, with a read-only verb first, a modality matching the cited item and at least one cite. Closed vocabulary: the sentence must also be contained under a closed vocabulary (owner decision N-j, taken after the whole-branch review showed that containment alone let negations, invented causes and reversed edges through): one line, at most 40 words, with no brackets, no quotes outside the snippet and no citation IDs; only the claim's own service names, and every other word from the frozen word list of its kind (the list contains no negations, causes or mutating verbs); the rank word, channel words, direction words, caller-before-callee order and pipeline name agree with the claim's fields; every number is a plain number matched to the claim's own evidence in its own unit: percent only for fractions, s/ms only for ms items, the before value before the after value, within ±1% or the stated precision; wall-clock times only in verification steps, as HH:MM inside the capture window, also across midnight (N-b, N-c, N-f, N-g, N-j). Rejection reasons are a closed set of 16 (design §5.5 plus word_not_allowed and malformed_sentence). Retry and fallback: a slot with any rejection gets one retry at the pinned temperature, carrying the rejected answer and the reasons; after that it gets the template's slot, logged as a fallback. A model error never fails a run (N-d). Storage: the narrative is stored in narrative_row and as step N of the signed CoE entry: claims, attempts, rejections, first-draft counts and rendered text, with tokens under cost and wall time under measured. Narrator tokens count in CpR (incident_usage); narrator time is outside TTT. Additive CoE fields: D-pipe items carry raw before/after levels with units (N-i): OTel latency in ms, errors per step, otherwise the metric name. Ranking, mu, sigma and the decision hash are unchanged. The T step carries window_start and window_end. Frozen parameters: data/frozen/narrator_params.json holds the direction words and the verbs (query, inspect, verify, check, filter); the per-kind vocabulary, plus the channel, rank and pipeline words; the tolerance, max 3 steps, the 40-word limit and the 12-character snippet minimum. Its hash (narrator_params) and, for LLM variants, the prompt SHA (narrator_prompt) are written into each CoE entry's parameter_hashes. The prompt lists the slot's allowed words. Confirmatory runs refuse a provisional narrator (the prompt for LLM variants, the parameters for all narrating variants) until the prompt round is chosen and frozen in entry C. Machine report: helios/evaluation/narrative_report.py gives per narrator: first-pass acceptance, rejections by reason, retry success, slot fallback rate, and sentence and slot shapes by source (N-h).
